title: With three nested row contexts, EARLIER ( column ) reads the middle one
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( T, "x", SUMX ( FILTER ( T, T[n] >= 2 ), SUMX ( FILTER ( T, T[n] = 1 ), EARLIER ( T[n] ) ) ) )

source.quote: The next evaluation level out is represented by 1; two levels out is represented by 2 and so on. When omitted default value is 1.
source.supports: the default is one level out

derivation: Row contexts when EARLIER is evaluated: ADDCOLUMNS (n = 1, 2 or 3), the outer SUMX (rows 2 and 3), the inner SUMX (row 1). One level out of the inner SUMX is the outer SUMX: for each of its rows the inner SUMX has one row and returns the outer SUMX value. 2 + 3 = 5 for every ADDCOLUMNS row.
